businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.description: The businesses you resell, with their minutes and chats this month. Their owners sign in at your dashboard address. Each business's audit log records who on your team opens it.
businesses.loadFailed: We couldn't load your businesses. Refresh to try again.

release.title: Release {{name}}?
release.description: {{email}} keeps {{name}} and its receptionist on the Free plan and takes over its billing. It leaves your console, and your team can't open it anymore.

errors.ownerRequired: {{name}} has no owner yet. Its owner has to accept their invitation first.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: You'll erase {{name}} with its calls, chats, contacts, appointments and settings, and give up its phone number. Its owner and team lose access, and you can't undo it.

errors.numberInProgress: We're still setting up {{name}}'s phone number. Try again in a few minutes.

empty.title: No businesses yet
empty.description: Create a business and invite its owner.
empty.memberDescription: Your partner's owners and admins create businesses here.

create.title: Create a business
create.description: Its owner gets an email from {{partnerName}} with a link to sign in.

access.full: Its team runs the receptionist: knowledge, hours, services and team members. They don't see billing, API keys or MCP.
access.activity: Its team sees calls, chats, appointments, contacts and messages. You set up the receptionist.

billing.outside: You bill this business yourself, and its owner signs in from the invitation.
billing.package: Its owner pays for this package from the invitation, then signs in.

errors.invalidName: Enter the business's name, up to 120 characters.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter one valid email address for the owner.
errors.domainRequired: You need a dashboard address before you can create a business. Ask {{appName}} to set one up.
errors.rateLimited: You created too many businesses. Try again in an hour.
errors.ownerOnTeam: Someone on your team can't own a business. Enter the email of the client who owns it.
errors.failed: We couldn't create the business. Try again.

billing.title: Billing for {{name}}
billing.description: Pick the package this business pays you for, or bill it yourself.
billing.outsideHint: The business pays nothing through Stripe, and no package limits its minutes or chats.
billing.packageHint: Its owner pays for the package on the business's billing page, or from the invitation if they haven't joined yet.

errors.subscriptionActive: This business pays for its package through Stripe. Cancel its subscription in your Stripe Dashboard first.
errors.packageGone: That package isn't for sale anymore. Pick another.
errors.notConnected: Connect your Stripe account before you sell packages.
errors.notConfigured: This dashboard can't sell packages yet.
errors.failed: We couldn't change how the business is billed. Try again.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: What you sell your businesses: a monthly price, an optional setup fee, and the minutes and chats each month includes.
packages.loadFailed: We couldn't load your packages. Refresh to try again.
packages.managersOnly: Only owners and admins can see packages.
packages.notConfigured: This dashboard can't connect a Stripe account yet. Until it can, you bill your businesses yourself.

connectFirst.owner: Connect your Stripe account to sell packages.
connectFirst.admin: Ask an owner to connect your Stripe account so you can sell packages.

packages.notReady: Stripe can't take payments on your account yet. You can create packages now, and businesses can buy them once Stripe turns payments on.

disconnected.owner: You disconnected your Stripe account, so its packages can't sell. Connect an account again to create new ones.
disconnected.admin: Your Stripe account is disconnected, so its packages can't sell. Ask an owner to connect an account again.

empty.title: No packages yet
empty.description: Create a package for your businesses to buy.

create.title: Create a package
create.description: Businesses on this package pay you this much each month, in {{currency}}, and get these minutes and chats.
create.fixedTerms: You can't change the price or the minutes and chats later, because businesses may already pay for them. You can rename the package.

errors.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.invalidPrice: Enter a monthly price above zero.
errors.invalidSetupFee: Enter a setup fee above zero, or leave it empty.
errors.invalidAllowance: Enter minutes and chats as whole numbers from 0 to 1,000,000.
errors.notConnected: Connect your Stripe account before you create packages.
errors.failed: We couldn't create the package. Try again.

rename.title: Rename package
rename.description: Stripe shows the new name on your businesses' invoices.
rename.notConnected: You can only rename packages on your connected Stripe account.
rename.failed: We couldn't rename the package. Try again.

archive.title: Stop selling {{name}}?
archive.description: New businesses can't buy it. Businesses already on it keep it.
archive.failed: We couldn't take the package off sale. Try again.

team.title: Team
team.description: People who can use this console.
team.loadFailed: We couldn't load the team. Refresh to try again.

invite.title: Invite someone to your team
invite.description: They get an email with a link to join {{partnerName}}.

roles.owner: Runs everything, including billing, the Stripe connection and deleting the partner.
roles.admin: Manages businesses, packages, branding, domains, keys and the team.

errors.failed: We couldn't send the invitation. Try again.
errors.rateLimited: You sent too many invitations. Try again in an hour.

errors.changeFailed: We couldn't change that role. Try again.
errors.removeFailed: We couldn't remove them. Try again.
errors.revokeFailed: We couldn't cancel that invitation. Try again.
errors.finalOwner: Your partner needs at least one owner.

branding.title: Branding & domain
branding.description: What your businesses see on your dashboard address, in the browser tab and in your emails.
branding.loadFailed: We couldn't load your brand. Refresh to try again.
branding.membersCantEdit: Only owners and admins can change the brand.

domain.title: Dashboard address
domain.none: You don't have an address of your own yet. Ask {{appName}} to set one up.

branding.nameHelp: Your businesses see it in the browser tab, above sign-in and as the sender of your emails.
branding.logoHelp: Shown above sign-in and in your emails. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 256 KB.
branding.faviconHelp: The icon in the browser tab. Without one, the tab shows your logo.

links.title: Links
links.description: Your sign-in page and dashboard link to these. Leave a field empty to hide its link.
links.supportEmailHelp: Replies to your emails go here. Without a support page, your support link opens this address.

errors.failed: We couldn't save your brand. Try again.
errors.name: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.color: Enter the color as a hex code, such as #0f766e.
errors.link: Enter each link as a full web address that starts with https://.
errors.imageType: Upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image.
errors.imageSize: Upload an image of 256 KB or smaller.
errors.forbidden: Only owners and admins can change the brand.

stripe.title: Stripe
stripe.description: Your businesses pay you through your own Stripe account. Stripe sends their invoices and receipts in your name.
stripe.loadFailed: We couldn't load your Stripe connection. Refresh to try again.
stripe.ownersOnly: Only owners can manage the Stripe connection.

notConfigured.title: No Stripe payments yet
notConfigured.description: This dashboard can't connect a Stripe account yet. Until it can, you bill your businesses yourself.

connect.title: Connect your Stripe account
connect.description: Stripe charges your businesses in your name and pays you out. You handle refunds and disputes in your Stripe Dashboard.
connect.countryHelp: Stripe sets your account's country when it creates the account, and you can't change it later.

onboarding.title: Finish setting up Stripe
onboarding.description: Stripe needs a few more details before your account can take payments.

restricted.title: Stripe can't take payments yet
restricted.description: Stripe is checking your details or needs more of them. Open Stripe to see what's left.

active.title: Your Stripe account is connected
active.description: Your businesses pay you in {{currency}}. You handle refunds and disputes in your Stripe Dashboard.

disconnected.title: You disconnected Stripe
disconnected.description: You disconnected your account in Stripe on {{date}}. Your businesses can't buy packages until you connect an account again.

errors.failed: We couldn't open Stripe. Try again.
errors.invalidCountry: Choose the country your business is in.
errors.notConfigured: This dashboard can't connect a Stripe account yet.
errors.changed: Someone else changed the Stripe connection. Refresh and try again.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Your code uses a platform key to create your businesses and set them up through the API. A key works on your businesses and no others.

restricted.title: Only owners and admins can manage platform keys
restricted.description: Ask an owner or admin on your team to create a key for you.

create.title: Create a platform key
create.description: Give the key a name you'll recognize and allow only the access it needs.

created.title: {{name}} is ready
created.description: Copy the key and store it in a password manager or your tool's settings.
created.warning: You won't see this key again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

revoke.title: Revoke this platform key?
revoke.description: Anything that uses {{name}} stops working right away. Its webhooks turn off, and nobody can accept the team invitations it sent. Owners it invited can still join their businesses. You can't undo this.
revoke.failed: We couldn't revoke the key. Try again.

scopes.business_read: Read business details, hours, services, and receptionist settings and rules
scopes.business_write: Update business details, hours, services, and receptionist settings and rules, including where calls are transferred
scopes.knowledge_read: Read knowledge entries, FAQs, websites and files
scopes.knowledge_write: Add, edit and delete knowledge entries, FAQs, websites and files
scopes.team_manage: Invite and remove team members and change roles
scopes.businesses_create: Create businesses and invite their owners
scopes.users_create: Invite owners to make an account

errors.rateLimited: You signed up too many partners today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.failed: We couldn't create the partner account. Try again.

acceptInvite.description: This invitation is for {{email}}, with the {{role}} role.
